# Bay Logistics, Inc.

Bay Logistics, Inc. is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Bay Logistics is a supply chain management firm providing solutions for transportation, warehousing, inventory management, order fulfillment, distribution, quality inspection, storage, and other logistics services. Bay Logistics, Inc. employs 167 people (+14.4% YoY, +21 people) and has an annual revenue of $41.2M, founded in 1992. Headquartered in Spring Lake, Michigan, United States, with offices in Romulus and Byron Center. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Ghana.

## About

BAY LOGISTICS is a comprehensive provider of supply chain management services including warehousing, transportation, logistics, repacking, sequencing, quality inspections, light assembly, packaging, sorting, kitting, local shuttle, and inventory management. BAY LOGISTICS'​ investment in facilities, infrastructure and IT systems allows clients to focus resources on core competencies and areas of expertise.

# Bay Logistik GmbH + Co. KG

Bay Logistik GmbH + Co. KG is a Transportation/Trucking/Railroad company. Bay Logistik is a company that specializes in transport and storage of liquid and granulated chemicals, both loosely and packaged. They aim to reduce costs and fully storage costs for their customers. Bay Logistik GmbH + Co. KG employs 20 people (-9.1% YoY, -2 people), founded in 1945. Headquartered in Waiblingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany, with presence in United States.

## About

Innovative Logistics Provider for Transport of liquid and dry bulk throughout Europe. 
We provide homegrown, but modern and efficient logistics. As specialists in our field, we implement any logistical solutions in a truly professional way.

Highly efficient and competitive logistics - throughout Europe. We focus on the use of reliable and renewable modern technology in all areas of our field.
Reliable, Renewable, Efficient and Flexible.
Transparency and quality in logistics since 1945. Our flexible and proven logistical solutions provide perfectly synchronized transport services, built on strong cooperation between customer and employee.

Among our other services, we store chemicals, both fluid and granulated in loose and packed up states, which allows us to reduce high storage costs to a minimum or even cut them entirely.
